payload.title: Memoize foldLog per ref-tip within a process
payload.body: readEvents is now O(1) git processes per fold (cat-file --batch), but several operations fold MORE THAN ONCE per process (e.g. claim does a check fold + appendWithRetry; render+stats+doctor each fold). Cache foldLog keyed on the current tasks-claims commit sha (currentClaimsCommit) so repeated folds in one process reuse the result; invalidate when the ref tip changes (after any append). Complements bound-git-native-fold-cost-at-scale (the read is cheap; this removes redundant reads). Surfaced implementing the batched readEvents.
